answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The pigment holds work receipts rather than names, so the karst of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, split across independent auditors, each submission carries a fresh nonce. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the ledge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
